---
title: Sorting, searching, and paging
---

`lt_interactive()` makes headers click-to-sort (shift-click adds tie-breakers), adds a search box that reads plain language such as `body_mass over 4500, species is Gentoo`, and pages the rows.

```{r}
library(lt)
d = penguins[, c("species", "island", "bill_len", "body_mass", "sex")]
lt(d) |>
  lt_interactive(sort = ~ species + -body_mass, pager = c(5, 10, Inf), filter = FALSE)
```
